# Questionnaire And Wizard Logic

Use this instruction when defining how coach answers are collected and translated into system decisions.

## Core Focus

- Ask about the coach's audience, including client type, expected client base, and access frequency.
- Ask about content type, size, and update frequency.
- Ask about authentication and access constraints, including free versus paid, one-time versus subscription, and login versus link access.
- Ask about branding inputs such as colors, logo, tone, and preferred product format.
- Ask about security and compliance needs, including NDA, terms, and region constraints such as GDPR.
- Map answers to technical rules through a documented rules engine.
- Keep the decision logic explainable internally.

## Checklist

- [ ] Define questions about client audience and usage patterns.
- [ ] Define questions about content format and update cadence.
- [ ] Define questions about access, payment, and authentication.
- [ ] Define questions about branding and experience type.
- [ ] Define questions about security and compliance.
- [ ] Map questionnaire responses to technical rules and defaults.
- [ ] Document the decision logic clearly for internal use.

## Output Expectations

- Avoid redundant questions when the answer can be inferred safely.
- Keep questions phrased in coach language, not implementation language.
- Every important answer should map to a visible system decision or configuration.
